{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Calculate conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = {}
for segment in df['customer_segment'].unique():
    segment_data = df[df['customer_segment'] == segment]
    total_orders = len(segment_data)
    converted_orders = segment_data['converted'].sum()
    conversion_rate = converted_orders / total_orders
    conversion_rates[segment] = conversion_rate

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = max(conversion_rates, key=conversion_rates.get)
best_rate = conversion_rates[best_segment]

print(f'Conversion rates by segment: {conversion_rates}')
print(f'Highest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.4f}')"}
